context:
# Goal
Mado round 13, axes coverage and operability. L1 is canonical planner. C1 coverage: sourced U4 protocol phase + advertised globals knowledge, 3/7 -> 4/7. C2 operability: replace set-blind Hypr source/local inventory with exact expected/observed set comparison, named missing/extra, covering hermetic cases. Existing checks must remain valid. No global routing changes.
# Contract
All paths absolute below /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin. Each seat is leaf; no delegation, no background jobs. Shared source files only have the named implementation owner. Everyone skips builds/lint/tests/formatters and smoke runs mid-flight; L1 verifies once after all seats finish. Read-only host probes specifically assigned are evidence collection, never compositor mutation. Host ~/.config, ~/.local/share, ~/.local/state, siblings and fleet repo are read-only. No secrets/session titles/raw environment/logs. Do not commit or push. Write only your explicit draft/report path. Authoring-lane reviewers do not count as outside-lane verification. Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read `/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md` first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report).
Return concrete findings and anchors. Source opens must include URL, access date, exact <=25-word quote + location, revision, tier, admission/rejection and flip. All output files under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-13/w1.
milestone: exact-set census and sourced U4 boundaries
